title: Non-BPS Monopoles and Dyons via Resurgent Transseries
summary: Radially symmetric non-BPS 't Hooft-Polyakov monopoles and dyons are constructed as resurgent transseries: infinite sums of exponentially decaying terms, each multiplied by a factorially divergent fluctuation factor. All higher exponential terms are explicitly expressed in terms of the leading order solutions. In the BPS limit all fluctuation terms truncate.
